hero.title: What Is the Dress Code on Crystal Cruises?
hero.subtitle: A complete guide to Day Casual, Evening Resort, and Formal Evening attire aboard Crystal Serenity and Crystal Symphony.

quickAnswer.heading: Refined Luxury Without Rigidity
paragraphs: Crystal Cruises has a relaxed yet refined dress code that allows guests to feel comfortable during the day while maintaining an elegant atmosphere in the evening. You do not need formal clothing every night, but you should plan to change out of daytime attire before dinner.

The dress code has three main categories: Day Casual, Evening Resort and Formal Evening. Day Casual applies until 6:00 p.m. After that, guests are expected to follow the evening attire listed in the ship's daily Reflections program.
Whether you are sailing aboard Crystal Serenity or Crystal Symphony, packing a combination of comfortable resort wear, smart evening outfits and one more formal look will help you feel prepared.

dressCodeAtAGlance.title: Crystal Cruises Dress Code at a Glance
rows: Sundresses, shorts, jeans, linen, T-shirts, polo shirts and poolwear with suitable cover-ups
Dresses, skirts, trousers, blouses, shirts, chinos, blazers and smart dark-wash jeans
Cocktail dresses, gowns, elegant evening separates, suits or tuxedos
dressCodeAtAGlance.note: The evening dress code applies in the ship's public areas and dining venues. Check the daily Reflections program and the Dress Code Itinerary supplied for your particular sailing, as the schedule can vary.

dayCasual.title: Day Casual: What to Wear During the Day
dayCasual.subtitle: Relaxed Daytime Comfort Across the Ship Until 6:00 P.M.
dayCasual.intro: Until 6:00 p.m., Crystal follows a relaxed Day Casual dress code. Guests can wear comfortable resort clothing around the ship, including in most restaurants.

included.title: Daytime Women's Attire
included.description: Sundresses, casual dresses, elegant shorts, jeans, comfortable trousers, linen clothing, lightweight tops, and swimsuits with cover-ups.

included.title: Daytime Men's Attire
included.description: Shorts, casual trousers, jeans, T-shirts, polo shirts, linen shirts, lightweight clothing, and swim shorts with a polo or T-shirt when away from the pool.

included.title: Casual Dining Venues Rule
included.description: Covered swimwear is permitted only at selected casual dining venues, including Trident Grill, Beefbar, and Marketplace. Guests must change before visiting other restaurants.

restrictions.title: Swimwear Indoors
restrictions.description: Swimwear on its own or wet swimwear is not permitted in public indoor areas.

restrictions.title: Bathrobes in Public
restrictions.description: Bathrobes outside of appropriate private stateroom or pool areas are strictly prohibited.

restrictions.title: Bare Feet & Tank Tops
restrictions.description: Bare feet and tank tops are not permitted in shared public spaces and restaurants.

restrictions.title: Baseball Caps & Revealing Clothing
restrictions.description: Baseball caps, revealing clothing, and apparel with offensive messages are not permitted.

eveningResort.title: Evening Resort: What to Wear After 6:00 p.m.
intro: Evening Resort is the standard refined evening style on Crystal Cruises. It is more polished than daytime resort wear without requiring a cocktail dress or tuxedo.
Guests should change before heading to dinner, bars, lounges and other evening activities.

items.title: Evening Attire for Women
paragraphs: Crystal's evening ambiance calls for polished, sophisticated resort dressing. Women typically wear dresses, tailored separates, and elegant jewelry that reflect high-end European coastal style.

lists.title: Recommended Wardrobe Pieces
items: Dark-wash jeans without rips or distressing

highlight.title: Styling Tip
highlight.text: Bring lightweight shawls or wraps for air-conditioned dining rooms and evening strolls along the teak promenade deck.

items.title: Evening Attire for Men
paragraphs: Men are expected to adopt a smart, tailored aesthetic after 6:00 p.m. Ties are never required for Evening Resort nights, but collared shirts and jackets create an appropriately refined look.

lists.title: Recommended Wardrobe Pieces
items: Dark-wash jeans without rips, paired with a jacket

highlight.title: What to Avoid in the Evening
highlight.text: Shorts, flip-flops, sliders, swimwear, hats, and casual daytime clothing are not appropriate in public areas and dining venues after 6:00 p.m. Tailored shorts are permitted only in Tastes Kitchen & Bar under Crystal's current pre-sailing guidance.

formalEvening.title: Formal Evening: Do You Need Formalwear?
formalEvening.subtitle: Elegance on Qualifying Voyages Longer Than Seven Days
formalEvening.description: Crystal includes a designated Formal Evening on sailings longer than seven days. Its Before You Sail Guide describes one optional ship-wide formal night on these voyages. When a Formal Evening is scheduled, Crystal's current onboard dress etiquette states that formal attire is mandatory in dining venues, bars and lounges after 6:00 p.m., except at Beefbar, where it is optional.

tabs.name: Women's Formal Attire
mainBrandStrengths: Cocktail dresses in silk, chiffon, or lace
Floor-length evening gowns or dressy maxi dresses
Elegant women's pantsuits or tuxedo-style tailoring
competitorStrengths: Evening skirts paired with dressy tops
Tailored evening trousers with an elegant blouse
Dress shoes or formal evening footwear with statement accessories

tabs.name: Men's Formal Attire
mainBrandStrengths: Classic dark suits (charcoal, navy, or black) with tailored trousers
Traditional black-tie tuxedos or dinner jackets
Pressed formal dress shirts with French cuffs
competitorStrengths: Dress shoes (polished oxfords, derbies, or loafers)
Neckties or bow ties (completely optional on Crystal)
Pocket squares and formal wristwatches to complete the look

tabs.name: Formal Night Frequency & Rules
mainBrandStrengths: Voyages 7 days or longer feature one optional ship-wide Formal Evening
Shorter sailings under 7 days generally do not include a designated Formal Evening
Always verify the Dress Code Itinerary provided with your pre-cruise documents
competitorStrengths: Mandatory in dining venues, bars, and lounges after 6:00 p.m. once scheduled
Beefbar Exception: Formal attire is explicitly optional at Beefbar on formal nights
A well-fitted suit or cocktail dress is completely acceptable in lieu of a tuxedo or gown

venueAndThemeGrid.title: Venues, Special Events & Specialty Dining Attire
venueAndThemeGrid.subtitle: DRESS CODES BY VENUE & THEMED NIGHTS

cards.title: Crystal White Extravaganza
cards.description: On voyages of seven days or longer, Crystal's Before You Sail Guide describes the Crystal White Extravaganza. Guests are invited to wear white for this celebratory evening. Popular choices include white sundresses, white trousers with a smart shirt, white linen ensembles, or white cocktail dresses. Check your daily program for date and details.

cards.title: Umi Uma by Nobu Matsuhisa
cards.description: Crystal recommends Evening Resort attire after 6:30 p.m. Formal attire is suggested for specialty dining on designated Formal Evenings, as well as for certain captain, officer, and recognition dinners.

cards.title: Osteria d'Ovidio
cards.description: Evening Resort attire is recommended after 6:30 p.m. for northern Italian fine dining. Formal attire is suggested on designated Formal Evenings and select special dinners.

cards.title: Beefbar
cards.description: Follow Day Casual guidance until 6:00 p.m. and Evening Resort attire after 6:00 p.m. Crystal specifically states that Formal Evening attire is optional at Beefbar, making it the top venue for guests preferring a relaxed evening.

cards.title: Waterside, Lounges & Bars
cards.description: Follow the dress code published for that evening in Reflections. Formal attire is mandatory in these venues on scheduled Formal Evenings after 6:00 p.m. (except at Beefbar).

packingGuide.title: What Should You Pack for a Crystal Cruise?
packingGuide.subtitle: A COMPLETE FOUR-PHASE PACKING ROADMAP

steps.title: Daytime Essentials
steps.description: Pack lightweight shirts, tops, and blouses; shorts, trousers, and comfortable jeans; sundresses or casual dresses; linen clothing for warm-weather itineraries; swimwear with suitable cover-ups; comfortable walking shoes; and sandals or casual footwear.

steps.title: Evening Resort Essentials
steps.description: Pack smart dresses or elegant separates; blouses, collared shirts, and smart trousers; chinos or dark-wash jeans without distressing; a versatile blazer or sports jacket; smart evening shoes; and a lightweight sweater or wrap for conditioned dining rooms.

steps.title: Formal Evening Essentials
steps.description: If your sailing is longer than seven days, pack one cocktail dress, gown, or elegant evening outfit for women; one well-tailored dark suit or tuxedo for men; formal dress shoes; and optional accessories such as ties, pocket squares, or evening jewelry.

steps.title: Destination-Specific Gear
steps.description: Tailor layers to your itinerary: Mediterranean summers demand breathable linens, sun protection, and sunglasses; cooler voyages require warm layers, a weather-resistant jacket, and sturdy walking shoes for cobblestones and shore excursions.

jeansCard.title: Can You Wear Jeans on Crystal?
pros: Daytime: Jeans are fully permitted throughout the ship until 6:00 p.m.
Evening Resort: Dark-wash jeans without rips or distressing are permitted
Men's evening jeans must be accompanied by a sports jacket or blazer
cons: Casual, distressed, faded, or ripped jeans are strictly forbidden after 6:00 p.m.
Jeans of any kind are not a substitute for formalwear on scheduled Formal Evenings
Lightweight trousers or chinos remain the safer, more polished evening recommendation

shortsCard.title: Can You Wear Shorts to Dinner?
pros: Daytime: Shorts are fully acceptable around the pool, lounges, and daytime dining
Covered swimwear and shorts are permitted at Trident Grill, Beefbar, and Marketplace
Limited evening exception: Tailored shorts are permitted only in Tastes Kitchen & Bar
cons: Shorts are not permitted in public areas, main dining, and lounges after 6:00 p.m.
Flip-flops, pool slides, and athletic shorts are prohibited after 6:00 p.m. shipwide
For all other dinner venues, switch to chinos, tailored trousers, skirts, or dresses

dressyVsCasual.heading: Is Crystal Cruises Dressy or Casual?
dressyVsCasual.quote: Crystal is best described as refined resort luxury. During the day, the atmosphere is relaxed and comfortable. In the evening, guests dress elegantly, with a designated Formal Evening on qualifying longer voyages. You do not need formalwear every night, but Crystal is definitely not a cruise line where daytime shorts, flip-flops, and poolwear are suitable for dinner.
dressyVsCasual.author: Angela Hughes
dressyVsCasual.authorRole: CEO of Trips & Ships Luxury Travel

angelaAdvice.heading: Pack with Purpose: Wardrobe Wisdom from 40+ Years at Sea
angelaAdvice.quote: When preparing for a luxury cruise, I recommend planning your wardrobe around the itinerary and the evening schedule rather than packing a completely different outfit for every day. For Crystal, comfortable daytime clothing, a few versatile Evening Resort outfits and one polished formal ensemble should cover most needs on a longer sailing. Choose fabrics that travel well and pieces that can be combined in different ways. Check your Dress Code Itinerary before departure so you know whether your voyage includes a Formal Evening or the Crystal White Extravaganza.
angelaAdvice.author: Angela Hughes

faqs.question: Is there a dress code on Crystal Cruises?
faqs.answer: Yes. Crystal has Day Casual attire until 6:00 p.m., Evening Resort attire after 6:00 p.m. and Formal Evening attire on designated formal nights.

faqs.question: Do I need a tuxedo on Crystal Cruises?
faqs.answer: No. A tuxedo is one option for men on a Formal Evening, but a suit is also suitable. Ties are optional.

faqs.question: How many formal nights are on a Crystal cruise?
faqs.answer: Crystal's Before You Sail Guide states that voyages longer than seven days have one optional ship-wide Formal Evening. Check your individual sailing's Dress Code Itinerary for confirmation.

faqs.question: Can I wear jeans on Crystal Cruises?
faqs.answer: Yes. Jeans are permitted during the day. Dark-wash jeans without rips can be worn as part of Evening Resort attire; men should pair them with a jacket.

faqs.question: Are shorts allowed on Crystal Cruises?
faqs.answer: Shorts are permitted during the day. They are not allowed in public areas and dining venues after 6:00 p.m., except for the limited tailored-shorts allowance at Tastes Kitchen & Bar.

faqs.question: Can I wear flip-flops to dinner?
faqs.answer: No. Flip-flops and sliders are not appropriate for evening public areas and dining venues.

faqs.question: Is formal attire required every night?
faqs.answer: No. Most evenings follow the Evening Resort dress code. Formal attire applies on the designated Formal Evening.

faqs.question: Does Crystal have a White Night?
faqs.answer: Crystal's Before You Sail Guide describes the Crystal White Extravaganza on voyages of seven days or longer. Check the daily program for the event details and date.

faqs.question: What should I wear to Umi Uma and Osteria d'Ovidio?
faqs.answer: Crystal recommends Evening Resort attire after 6:30 p.m. Formal attire is suggested on Formal Evenings and certain special dinners.

faqs.question: Does Crystal provide bathrobes and slippers?
faqs.answer: Yes. Crystal's Before You Sail Guide states that bathrobes, kimonos and slippers are provided in each suite. These are for appropriate private or pool-related use, not for wearing in public dining venues.

finalCta.title: Plan Your Crystal Cruise with Expert Guidance
finalCta.description: Choosing the right Crystal voyage involves more than selecting a ship and itinerary. Understanding the onboard atmosphere, dining experiences, accommodation and practical details can help you prepare for a more enjoyable journey. At Trips & Ships Luxury Travel, Angela Hughes and her team can help you compare Crystal itineraries, understand the onboard experience and plan a voyage that matches your travel preferences.
